scripts.dev:raw: concurrently -n server,worker,client -c cyan,yellow,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix worker" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:worker: bash ./scripts/ensure-dist.sh && npm run db:local --prefix worker; npm run dev --prefix worker
scripts.build: npm ci --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && rm -rf client/dist/words
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run words:upload && npm run deploy --prefix worker
